title: World Cup: Houston NASA Space Center Ticket & Live Spanish Guide
includes: Tips on maximizing NASA experience and booking free tram tours based on NASA's availability
Skip-the-line at entrance gate with your Spanish-speaking guide
General Admission (GA) ticket to the NASA Space Center
Round-trip transportation from meeting point to NASA Space Center
Spanish-speaking Guide who will accompany you inside NASA Space Center and take photos per request
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Solo Travelers should contact us directly for tour availability. Solo Travelers may also purchase 2 tickets to ensure Spanish tour operation.
On holidays, guests will be taken to the NASA Space Center first and do the Tunnel tour following their return from NASA.
Tram Tours at the Space Center are subject to availability determined by NASA dependent on seasonal & staffing factors.

Upon payment of tour fees, the tour booking leader & the accompanying participant(s) acknowledge they agree to Astroville Tours' Terms of Service where the link can be found at the ticket once booked.
Children below age of 6 are welcome to join the tour but require their own valid ticket.

Please make every effort to meet your tour guide on time. Failure to arrive on time may result in a postponed tour subject to tour availability or an abandoned tour if we do not hear from you in advance of the scheduled start time.
Tour is offered rain or shine. In the event of bad weather, travelers may opt to reschedule for another date free of charge at their own discretion.
Video recording of tour is not permitted (repeated violations are subject to copyright laws).
Not recommended for travelers with limited mobility or require frequent stops
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
With this combo package, enjoy round-trip transportation and general admission tickets to Space Center Houston with your Spanish-speaking guide who will navigate your group through the Space Center's most noteworthy exhibits, presentation theaters, and the amazing "Rocket Park". 

During this 5 hour daily excursion, our expert guide will have you experiencing the Space Center like a true NASA All-Star including the amazing Independence Plaza, International Space Station, Life on Mars, Starship Gallery and tram tours! 

With so many amazing things including the Saturn V Rocket and Rocket Park, our expert guide can also take group photos for memories to last a lifetime!
